scientific_integrity: Analytic unrestricted theorem supported by exact conditional identities, harmonic asymptotics, Bonferroni, Borel–Cantelli; finite rational enumeration verifies small cases only.
scientific_limitations: Two iid parents per vertex; rooted simple triangles only; no arbitrary parent count or edge-multiplicity extension proved. Historical priority is best knowledge of inspected sources and is not independently certified.
title: The last root-containing triangle has an infinite-mean birth time in a two-parent recursive graph
